doc.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 5, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Goodbyes
summary: Thanks, compliments on the book, and signing off.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well you figured out how to make it all work and I really admire it. And you’ve made some wonderful —
Well I’m glad you liked the book, I’m glad you liked the book.
Yes indeed. So thank you again, this has been beyond my expectations once again.
Monk, call me twenty years from now and we’ll do it again.
I mean that. I may not be with it but some things good will come out of my brain if I’m talking to you.
All right. I’m going to sign off and then we’ll say our official good-byes.
